# Engineering rules

Only you can see this file. The rest of the team needs these facts.

- Harbor depends on Ember, so Harbor must launch in a later week than Ember.
- Indigo depends on Harbor, so Indigo must launch in a later week than Harbor.
- Beacon depends on Garnet, so Beacon must launch at least 3 weeks after Garnet.
- Beacon has to launch no later than week 7.
